name: v_bsid
sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW model."v_bsid" AS SELECT t0."BUKRS" AS "BUKRS", t0."KUNNR" AS "KUNNR", t0."GJAHR" AS "GJAHR", t0."BELNR" AS "BELNR", t0."BUZEI" AS "BUZEI", t0."BLDAT" AS "BLDAT", t0."ZFBDT" AS "ZFBDT", t0."ZBD1T" AS "ZBD1T", t0."DMBTR" AS "DMBTR", t0."WAERS" AS "WAERS", t1."KUNNR" AS "KNA1__KUNNR", t1."NAME1" AS "KNA1__NAME1", t1."LAND1" AS "KNA1__LAND1", t1."ORT01" AS "KNA1__ORT01", t1."KTOKD" AS "KNA1__KTOKD", t1."ERDAT" AS "KNA1__ERDAT", CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE) AS "due_date", DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE), CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)) AS "days_overdue", CASE WHEN CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE) IS NULL THEN NULL WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE), CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)) <= 0 THEN 'not_due' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE), CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)) <= 30 THEN '1-30' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE), CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)) <= 60 THEN '31-60' WHEN DATE_DIFF('DAY', CAST(t0."ZFBDT" + t0."ZBD1T" * INTERVAL '1' DAY AS DATE), CAST('2026-06-30' AS DATE)) <= 90 THEN '61-90' ELSE '90+' END AS "aging_bucket" FROM "BSID" AS t0 LEFT JOIN "KNA1" AS t1 ON LPAD(CAST(t0."KUNNR" AS TEXT), 10, '0') = t1."KUNNR"

name: v_vbap
sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW model."v_vbap" AS SELECT t0."VBELN" AS "VBELN", t0."POSNR" AS "POSNR", t0."MATNR" AS "MATNR", t0."KWMENG" AS "KWMENG", t0."NETWR" AS "NETWR", t1."VBELN" AS "VBAK__VBELN", t1."ERDAT" AS "VBAK__ERDAT", t1."KUNNR" AS "VBAK__KUNNR", t1."VKORG" AS "VBAK__VKORG", t1."WAERK" AS "VBAK__WAERK", t1."NETWR" AS "VBAK__NETWR", t2."MATNR" AS "MARA__MATNR", t2."MTART" AS "MARA__MTART", t2."MATKL" AS "MARA__MATKL", t2."MEINS" AS "MARA__MEINS", t2."ERSDA" AS "MARA__ERSDA", t3."KUNNR" AS "KNA1__KUNNR", t3."NAME1" AS "KNA1__NAME1", t3."LAND1" AS "KNA1__LAND1", t3."ORT01" AS "KNA1__ORT01", t3."KTOKD" AS "KNA1__KTOKD", t3."ERDAT" AS "KNA1__ERDAT", t4."MATNR" AS "MAKT__MATNR", t4."SPRAS" AS "MAKT__SPRAS", t4."MAKTX" AS "MAKT__MAKTX", CAST(TRY_STRPTIME(t1."ERDAT", '%Y%m%d') AS DATE) AS "VBAK__ERDAT_date" FROM "VBAP" AS t0 LEFT JOIN "VBAK" AS t1 ON t0."VBELN" = t1."VBELN" LEFT JOIN "MARA" AS t2 ON t0."MATNR" = t2."MATNR" LEFT JOIN "KNA1" AS t3 ON t1."KUNNR" = t3."KUNNR" LEFT JOIN "MAKT" AS t4 ON t4."MATNR" = t2."MATNR" AND t4."SPRAS" = 'E'
